subject: Hospitality
title: The Pass: Where Kitchen Meets Dining
description: A 60-second lesson on The Pass: Where Kitchen Meets Dining.

hook.text: The 'pass' is the counter where finished plates wait to be served. It's where the kitchen world meets the dining room.

buildup.text: The head chef or expeditor stands at the pass, inspecting every plate. Wrong garnish, cold food, or bad plating gets sent back.

discovery.text: Communication at the pass follows strict call-and-response: 'Ordering two lamb!' 'Yes, chef!' Clarity prevents chaos.

twist.text: The pass is also where kitchen stress peaks. During a busy service, every second at the pass feels like a bottleneck.

climax.text: A smooth pass means a smooth restaurant. When the pass breaks down, the entire dining experience collapses.

punchline.text: One counter, total control. The pass is where standards are enforced.

quiz.question: What happens at 'the pass' in a restaurant kitchen?
options: Finished plates are inspected before reaching guests
